manufacturer.name: Nice
manufacturer.note: Italian gate, door and barrier automation manufacturer. It serves its instruction PDFs from one flat directory, sites/default/files/upload/manuals, named by document code - which makes that directory the single highest-value harvest target in this registry. Its professional-area download index is paginated and a search result surfaced page 71, so the manual set behind it runs to hundreds of documents; what is recorded here is a sample.
